In that case the Abducted Persons (Recovery and Restoration) Act of 1949 was not held to be unconstitutional under article 14 upon the ground that it extended only to the several States mentioned in section 1(2), for in the opinion of the court classification could well be made on a geographical basis.

precedents.case_name: State of Punjab v. Ajaib Singh
precedents.cited_proposition: Classification on geographical basis permissible under article 14, e.g., Abducted Persons Act extending to specific states; abducted persons in those states form a class.
